data-steward._comment: The two agent-reachable launchers live in an isolated bin/agent/ directory so that no allowlisted path is a string prefix of a privileged sibling entrypoint (vcops-operator, vcops-workflow, vcrun-control, and the *.py implementations all live in bin/, never bin/agent/). This keeps the boundary safe under exact-match, prefix-match, or glob matcher semantics rather than depending on OpenClaw matching these paths exactly.
